name: ParsChat
author: parstechai

sections.description:
The ParsChat plugin seamlessly connects your website to the intelligent
ParsChat chatbot. By entering your bot token in the plugin settings,
you enable automatic integration of chatbot scripts on your site.
This allows visitors to interact with the ParsChat AI directly, enhancing user engagement and support without manual script management.

External Scripts

This plugin loads an external JavaScript file from:
https://pars-prod-pub.hel1.your-objectstorage.com/plugin/parschat_plugin_main.js

The script is required for the chatbot to function correctly.
No other external resources are loaded.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the Parschat wordpress plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Parschat tab in menu screen to Enter the plugin and add you’re token in input.
    4.click on submit button to save your token and add the chatbot to your website.
